LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.ModeDesc:
Switch this arm's job. Its gripper reaches into the cell it takes from; it puts down on the cell behind it.

Loader: takes from the storage at its gripper and puts onto the conveyor behind it, sending only what the network's machine still needs.

Feeder: gripper towards the end of a belt; puts what arrives into the machine input behind it (factory hopper or conveyor, the repair centre's item spot, or storage). Anything no longer wanted is set down beside it.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LoaderNoBelt: No conveyor behind it to put onto. (The gripper faces the storage it takes from.)
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LoaderNoFeeder: Its belt does not lead to a Feeder (one at the end of the belt, or with its gripper on the belt as it passes).
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.NoMachine: Nothing to feed behind the Feeder: no factory machine input, repair centre item spot or storage there. (The gripper faces the belt.)
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LoaderBeltBusy: Waiting for room on the belt.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.MachineSatisfied: The machine needs nothing right now.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.MachineCovered: Everything the machine needs is already on its way.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LoaderNoStock: Waiting for more to turn up in its storage: the machine still needs {0}.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.FeederPaused: Paused: its belts already lead to {0}.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.FeederSlotFull: The machine's input is full; holding the belt.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.FeederDropped: Set down {0}: nothing wants it any more.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LiftNoPartner: No partner lift. Build one on the same spot a level up or down, or link one by hand.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LiftPartnerNoBelt: No conveyor in front of the partner lift.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LiftWaiting: Waiting for room on the partner's belt.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LiftLinkDesc: Choose another conveyor lift for this one to send to. A link made by hand overrides the automatic pairing between levels.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LiftUnlinkDesc: Remove the hand-made link and go back to pairing with the lift a level up or down.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.FeederPriorityDesc: When this Feeder's belts start at a belt junction, a higher priority gets first claim on what comes down the trunk. Feeders of equal priority take turns.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.FeedingFromJunction: Feeding the {0} through a junction ({1} loader(s) on its own belts).
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.ServingJunction: Loading a junction trunk for {0} machine(s).
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.JunctionSummary: Splitting to {0} machine(s), fed by {1} loader(s) on the trunk.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.JunctionNoBranches: No branch belts lead from this junction to a Feeder.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.JunctionWaiting: Holding {0} until its branch has room.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.ArmReverseDesc: Turn the arm round where it stands, so it takes from the side it was putting down on and puts down on the side it was taking from.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.ArmRotateDesc: Turn the arm a quarter turn where it stands. The gripper reaches into the cell it takes from; it puts down on the cell behind it.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LiftRotateDesc: Turn the side this lift puts items out on a quarter turn clockwise.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LoaderSourceEmpty: Nothing in the storage at its gripper. (The gripper faces the storage it takes from.)
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LoaderRefused: The {0} will not take anything in its storage. First item, {1}: {2}.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.RefusedByStorage: not allowed by the storage's settings
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.ArmHolding: Holding {0} until there is room to set it down.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.ServingMany: Loading for {0} machines along this belt.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.ReturnLeftoversDesc: When on, this Loader watches the belt behind it for items that no machine on that belt still needs - counting everything already on its way - and puts them back where it takes from: into its storage (if the storage accepts them and has room), or onto the belt at its gripper. On a looping belt, leftovers go home at the first Loader that can take them.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LoaderReturned: Returning {0}: no machine on its belt needs it.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.BeltDropDesc: Kick whatever this belt piece is carrying off it, onto the floor beside the line (never onto another belt or arm).
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.LoaderWatchingBelt: Watching the belt at its gripper for what its own belt needs: {0}.
